dedupe_keys.name: statistical data on industry production at provincial level of vietnam

description: A Viet Nam energy-system deposit bundles provincial industrial production statistics from the General Statistics Office. The public 27 KB ZIP is labelled CC BY 4.0 by Zenodo. Its description names gross industry output at current prices and its structure by province for 2005 to 2010, plus provincial industrial-production indices for 2012 to 2017. These series could be used as historical industrial activity drivers for electricity-demand or freight-infrastructure simulations. They are statistical aggregates, not individual plant locations or future production forecasts. The page does not give the industry classification, units for every workbook, a harmonised 2011 bridge or later revisions. Upstream GSO terms remain separate from the deposited copy licence label. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these three provincial tables. The ZIP was not downloaded, so column names, province identifiers and the gap between periods remain unchecked.
